details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the working directory, the npm user the publisher and the protocol, plus an x-beacon-package header. index.js also fires the same beacon when the module is required, and exports a no-op Proxy so that a build importing the name completes instead of crashing. The beacon collects only host and install metadata: no environment variable values, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted. The README describes the package as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test and credits researcher Kero (@0xWise).
